g.text: Within-seed differences; fixed sparse policy; matched 2,048-tick probes
Diamonds and bars: mean +/- sample SD of 3 paired seed differences; small circles/squares/triangles: seeds 0/1/2.
Each series holds the other factors fixed. Coverage contrasts use the short condition shared by both training supports.
Fixed training ticks do not ensure equal task exposures; wider timing coverage also changes event density.
